description: LINEAR is a design and architecture magazine covering the world's most considered spaces. This MCP is a read-only window into LINEAR's curated archive: search design-led stays and spaces by city, architect, mood, or budget, and get the full record on any property - the design story, the architect, the details that matter. It never writes, books, reserves, or prices anything. When you want to stay somewhere, it hands you a link to LINEAR Concierge, a human-run travel desk - you submit the request yourself, and a person confirms every booking before any payment.

defaultPrompt: I’m planning a trip to New York. What should I see?
